infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Macro uses the camera to scan food barcodes.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Macro reads your step count from the phone's motion sensors to show daily activity. Nothing leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Macro reads your steps, distance, active energy, workouts and weight to show your activity. Health data never leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Macro uses speech recognition to log food by voice.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Macro uses the microphone for voice food logging.
